items.title: Beagle ka safar aur Darwin ke mushahidat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Darwin's observations (PDF 216-217).

blocks.text: Safar ke dauran Darwin ne garam mamaalik ke barsaati jangal aur doosre naye maskan dekhe jahan paudon aur janwaron ka aisa tanawwu tha jo us ne kabhi nahi dekha tha. Us ne fossils wali chattanein payin jo batati thin ke bar-e-azam aur samandar waqt ke saath bohat badle aur badal rahe hain, aur us ne dev qamat maadoom mammals ke fossils khod nikale, jo dikhate the ke jandar maazi mein bohat mukhtalif the aur waqt ke saath badalte hain.

Galapagos Islands par, jinhein kitab 16 chhote jazeeron ka group batati hai, us ne dekha ke paude aur janwar har jazeere par mukhtalif hain: aik jazeere ke dev qamat kachhuon ke khol zeen jaise aur doosre ke gumbad jaise the. Bohat se paude aur janwar doosre jazeeron ke bajaye South America ke paudon aur janwaron se zyada milte the, aur finch ki mukhtalif species ki chonchein mukhtalif theen jo mukhtalif jazeeron par bilkul mukhtalif ghizaen khane ke liye dhali theen.

Darwin ne yeh samjhane ki koshish ki ke finch ki species jazeeron mein kaise phaili hain. Us ne nateeja nikala ke nayi species ka banna aur dhalao gehre taur par jure hain: asal maskan se alag hone ke baad mukhtalif mahol ke dhalao aahista jama hone se aik purani shakal se nayi species banti hai, yahan tak ke kai naslon mein do aabadiyan itni mukhtalif ho jati hain ke alag species kehlayen.

blocks.alt: Pankhe numa (fan) khaaka: aadhe daire ke gird das finches ke sar. Baayen: Vegetarian tree finch, Large insectivorous tree finch, Small insectivorous tree finch, Woodpecker finch (kaanta pakre); oopar: Warbler finch; daayen: Cactus ground finch, Sharp-beaked ground finch, Small ground finch, Medium ground finch, Large ground finch.

blocks.long_description: Bahar ka chhalla: Tree finches, Warbler finch, Ground finches; darmiyani chhalla chonch ki qismein: Parrotlike bill, Grasping bills, Probing bills, Crushing bills; andar khurak: Fruit eaters, Insect eaters, Cactus eaters, Seed eaters.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khaake ko andar se bahar parhein: beech mein finch ki khurak (phal, keere, cactus, beej), us ke gird chonch ki qisam, aur sab se bahar finch ka group. Har finch ka sar apne hisse ke saamne hai: beej khane wale ground finches ki chonch moti aur mazboot (crushing) hai, keere khane walon ki patli (probing ya grasping). Aik hi buzurg se aaye finches mukhtalif khurak ke liye mukhtalif chonch mein dhal gaye.

blocks.prompt: Finch ki mukhtalif chonchon ne Darwin ko kya ishara diya?
blocks.explanation: Ke yeh mukhtalif jazeeron par mukhtalif ghizaon ke liye dhalao hain, aur alag aabadiyan dhalao jama kar ke nayi species ban sakti hain.

items: Fossils ne dikhaya ke zindagi aur zameen waqt ke saath badalti hain.
Galapagos ke kachhue aur finches har jazeere par mukhtalif the.
Alag aabadiyon mein dhalao jama hone se nayi species banti hain.
